name: claude-subagent-statusline
description: Live statusline for Claude Code with sub-agent delegation tracking.

plugins.name: claude-subagent-statusline
plugins.description: Tracks Task (sub-agent) delegations via PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks and renders a context-window bar plus running and completed counters.

plugins.description: Claude Desktop (Code tab) mod: a band above the prompt with project, model, effort, cost, context, elapsed time, sub-agent counters, 5h and weekly usage, and one row per running sub-agent.
